notes.title: New languages! (and bug fixes)
notes.notes:
In this Alien Paradise update, players who speak Spanish, French or Japanese can travel Brazil with the most synasthesic and touristic alien in the galaxy in your prefered language

This update also solves the following issues:

 Error that were stopping players from unlocking the achievements "No Help Needed" and "Three's a Lot!"
 Navigation problems when leaving the Settings screen, that could send the player back to the wrong mode
 Being sent back to the Story Mode while playing Quickplay if the level was played again

notes.title: New update: QoL enhancements
notes.notes:
Clearer feedbacks: if you overclick, the game displays the information in a less confusing way, as the overclick messages don't overwrite the hit or miss feedback
Music on repeat: background music for some of the navigation screens don't stop abruptly when reaching its looping point
Legal stuff: some important information regarding copyright was added to the game credits
Minor enhancements and fixes

notes.title: First update
